To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) shading is the most effective cue for depth perception, 2) texture is the second most effective cue for perceiving depth, and 3) aerial perspective is the least effective cue for depth.

In a perceptual matching study, participants perceived virtual objects to be closer to the real-world target when they were shaded with realistic shading, had a realistic cast shadow, and had realistic aerial perspective.
shading, cast shadows and aerial perspective are the most effective cues for depth perception, while texture, dimensionality, and billboarding are not as effective.
